tools.open_url: Opens a website in your browser
tools.look_at_screen: Looks at your screen right now (windows, text, errors, code…)
tools.read_webpage: Reads a page in the background without opening a browser
tools.open_folder_by_name: Finds and opens a folder by name (default: Desktop)
tools.check_windows_security: Reads basic protections: Defender, firewall, SmartScreen, UAC, updates
tools.watch_startup_programs: Compares startup programs with a saved baseline and reports changes
tools.find_suspicious_processes: Looks for malware traces among running processes
tools.stop_process: Ends a process by PID (asks for approval)
tools.remove_startup_program: Stops a program from starting with Windows (asks for approval)
tools.restore_startup_program: Restores a removed startup entry (asks for approval)
tools.enable_protection: Turns ON Defender real-time protection and/or the firewall (never off)
tools.network_connections: Lists which program is connected to which address
tools.check_link: Checks a link for phishing WITHOUT opening it
tools.cookie_guard: Checklist against account theft via cookies
tools.scan_project: Scans a folder for exposed API keys/passwords and files that shouldn't be published
tools.list_folder: Lists the contents of a folder
tools.read_file: Reads a file: code, text, PDF, Word, Excel, image
tools.edit_file: Changes or deletes ONE part of a text/code file
tools.write_file: Creates a new file and writes into it
tools.set_voice: Adjusts FENIX's own voice: rate, pitch, volume
tools.save_shortcut: Saves a shortcut command: several tasks in one sentence
tools.forget: Deletes conversations/notes containing a given text from memory (asks first)
tools.inspect_system: Snapshot of your computer: top CPU/RAM processes, startup apps, listening ports, disk usage
tools.inspect_website_security: Passive security observations for a website: TLS, DNS, domain record…
tools.check_project_security: Checks your OWN project folder before publishing
tools.export_report: Exports a report from My reports to Word/PDF
tools.delete_file: Moves a file/folder to the Recycle Bin (never permanent)
tools.adjust_volume: Changes the volume relatively or mutes
tools.set_radio: Turns Wi-Fi or Bluetooth on/off or reports status
tools.media_control: Controls playing music/video: play/pause, next, previous, stop
tools.power_action: Locks the screen, turns it off, or puts the PC to sleep (asks first)
tools.window_action: Window management: list, minimize all, restore, focus…
tools.close_front_app: 'Close this': gently closes the front window (never FENIX itself)
tools.pc_awareness: Describes what's happening on the computer; closes nothing
tools.scan_pc: Scans the computer: apps, folder names, devices (names only, no contents)
